an10.98:1.1: dasahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu yassaṃ yassaṃ disāyaṃ viharati phāsuyeva viharati
an10.98:1.5: samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā
an10.98:1.6: diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattāni vinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso
an10.98:1.8: dhammakāmo hoti piyasamudāhāro abhidhamme abhivinaye uḷārapāmujjo
an10.98:1.10: pāsādiko hoti abhikkantapaṭikkante susaṃvuto antaragharepi nisajjāya
an10.98:1.11: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an10.98:1.12: āsavānañca khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an10.98:1.13: imehi kho bhikkhave dasahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu yassaṃ yassaṃ viharati phāsuyeva viharatīti.
